review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Talent Partner based in India. Join a mission-driven organization that connects exceptional technical talent with high-impact social sector organizations working to improve lives at scale. As a Technical Talent Partner, you will lead end-to-end recruitment for technical positions, both internally and across a global portfolio of technology-focused nonprofits. You will identify experienced engineers, product managers, and data professionals who can apply their industry expertise to challenges in health, education, livelihoods, and public services. Working closely with hiring managers and technical teams, you will build targeted sourcing strategies, strengthen candidate assessment, and develop referral networks. You will also leverage AI-powered tools to improve recruiting efficiency, uncover promising candidates, and optimize hiring workflows. This is an opportunity to shape a growing talent function while helping high-performing social impact organizations access the technical expertise they need to scale. Accountabilities Technical Talent Sourcing: Map technical talent markets, particularly in India, to identify companies, communities, and professional networks that produce strong engineering, product, and data talent. Develop targeted sourcing strategies and use AI tools to discover qualified candidates, expand talent pools, and personalize outreach at scale. Candidate Screening and Assessment: Conduct structured screening conversations to evaluate candidates' actual contributions, technical experience, decision-making abilities, and problem-solving approaches. Develop evidence-based screening questions that distinguish demonstrated expertise from general claims of experience. Hiring Manager Partnership: Collaborate with hiring managers to define role requirements, establish clear hiring criteria, and calibrate candidate assessments. Challenge job specifications when they do not reflect business needs and coordinate with technical teams to ensure promising candidates progress to technical interviews. Referral Program Development: Build a sustainable referral engine that encourages employees, candidates, and professional networks to recommend qualified talent. Expand the candidate database and establish referral practices that become an integral part of the recruitment process. Talent Community and Event Management: Plan and deliver recruitment events in collaboration with venture capital firms, technical communities, and industry networks across India, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, and the United States. Candidate Engagement and Compensation: Communicate the value of social impact careers to experienced professionals who may be unfamiliar with the organizations or opportunities available. Manage compensation discussions, address counteroffers, maintain candidate engagement, and support successful transitions from offer acceptance to onboarding. Recruitment Operations and Process Improvement: Manage the end-to-end hiring process, maintain timely communication, and ensure candidates progress efficiently through each stage. Track sourcing channels, conversion rates, hiring timelines, and candidate drop-off points to identify opportunities for improvement. AI-Enabled Recruitment: Integrate AI into sourcing, candidate research, outreach, and other recruitment activities. Evaluate the effectiveness of automated workflows, identify limitations, and refine processes to improve productivity without compromising candidate quality. Recruitment Playbook Development: Document successful sourcing strategies, screening practices, hiring insights, and process improvements to create repeatable recruitment frameworks that strengthen future searches. Requirements Professional Experience: At least 5 years of experience recruiting for technical roles, including a minimum of 2 years in an in-house recruiting position at a product-focused company. Technical Recruitment Expertise: Demonstrated ability to recruit engineers, product managers, and other technical professionals, with a solid understanding of software development and product-building environments. Candidate Evaluation Skills: Ability to conduct in-depth screening conversations, assess individual ownership of projects, probe technical decision-making, and identify gaps between claimed experience and demonstrated expertise. Sourcing Expertise: Strong knowledge of the Indian technical talent market, including relevant companies, professional communities, and sourcing channels. Experience developing targeted sourcing strategies and engaging passive candidates is essential. AI and Automation Proficiency: Hands-on experience using AI to improve recruitment or other professional workflows. You should be able to explain what you automated, the efficiency gains achieved, and the limitations or errors you encountered. Hiring Manager Collaboration: Experience partnering with multiple hiring managers simultaneously, balancing differing expectations, role requirements, and compensation budgets while maintaining consistent assessment standards. Structured Recruitment Practices: Ability to design screening questions, establish evaluation criteria, monitor recruitment metrics, and use data to improve hiring outcomes. Communication and Relationship Building: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong stakeholder management abilities, and the confidence to engage senior technical professionals and explain opportunities that may offer meaningful impact rather than the highest salary. Independence and Adaptability: A proactive, organized, and analytical approach to managing multiple searches in a remote, asynchronous environment, with the ability to take ownership of recruitment outcomes. Preferred Qualifications: Experience sourcing technical talent in African markets, a technical background or hands-on exposure to technology, and experience recruiting for organizations that are less established or unable to compete with larger employers on compensation. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in India, with flexibility to structure your schedule around your time zone and responsibilities. Flexible Working Environment: An asynchronous-first culture that prioritizes outcomes, autonomy, and effective collaboration over rigid working hours. Meaningful Social Impact: Help experienced technology professionals transition into roles where their expertise can support organizations improving health, education, livelihoods, and public services for millions of people. High Ownership: Build and lead the technical talent function, establishing recruitment strategies, processes, and best practices from the ground up. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with an experienced technical team and operational colleagues in a collaborative environment with minimal hierarchy and short feedback loops. AI-Driven Innovation: Experiment with and implement AI-powered recruitment workflows, with the opportunity to shape how technology improves talent sourcing and assessment. International Exposure: Engage with technical talent markets, professional communities, and mission-driven organizations across India, Africa, and the United States. Professional Growth: Develop expertise in strategic talent acquisition, technical assessment, recruitment analytics, and talent market development. Compensation: Salary and other employment benefits were not specified in the original job description and can be clarified during the recruitment process. Proforce, Panatta, TYR ve Styku gibi uluslararası spor markalarının Türkiye temsilcisi olarak perakende, e-ticaret ve kurumsal alanlarda hizmet vermektedir. Maslak İstanbul ofisinde çalışmak üzere, çok markalı yapımız ve büyüyen dijital varlığımız için yaratıcı, dinamik bir Sosyal Medya Uzmanı arıyoruz. İyi derecede İngilizce: global trendleri takip edebilme ve uluslararası markaların yöneticileri ile iletişim kurabilme. Spor, wellness, gıda takviyesi veya e-ticaret sektörlerinde deneyim.

review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Marketing Operations, LATAM
review_candidates.description: About Crunchyroll Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love. Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime! About The Role Crunchyroll is seeking a Senior Manager, Marketing Operations to build and run the operational backbone for marketing execution across Latin America. This role will turn regional priorities into clear workflows, workback plans, asset requirements, approvals, and launch-ready execution across multiple markets, languages, and channels. You will partner with GTM & Growth, Brand & Community, Lifecycle, Curation, Partnerships, Creative, Communications, and global Centers of Excellence to ensure teams can move quickly without sacrificing quality or clarity. Success in this role requires strong program management, process design, and the ability to simplify complex cross-functional execution. The role is accountable for the systems and operating discipline behind execution—not for replacing channel or campaign strategy owners. What You’ll Do Integrated Marketing Operations: Build and maintain the operating framework that translates LATAM marketing priorities into executable plans, with clear owners, milestones, dependencies, and delivery dates. Campaign Workflow Management: Own campaign intake, briefing, workback schedules, approvals, status tracking, and launch-readiness processes across regional marketing initiatives. Asset & Localization Operations: Coordinate asset requirements, transcreation/localization workflows, versioning, approvals, delivery, and final-market readiness across Spanish LATAM and Portuguese Brazil. Cross-Channel Coordination: Connect Lifecycle, Curation, Brand, Partnerships, Communications, and other channel owners so execution plans are synchronized and teams have visibility into changes and dependencies. Tools & Process Ownership: Establish strong usage and governance for workflow tools such as Wrike and related planning systems; simplify templates, handoffs, and operating routines to reduce friction and duplicated work. Creative & Resource Operations: Partner with Creative and regional/global resource owners to forecast capacity, sequence priorities, coordinate external vendors or agencies where needed, and surface resource constraints early. Budget & Vendor Coordination: Support operational tracking of campaign spend, POs, vendor deliverables, and production commitments in partnership with Finance, Procurement, and budget owners. Launch Readiness & Risk Management: Maintain a clear view of campaign risks, approvals, missing assets, localization blockers, and dependencies; escalate issues early and drive closure before launch. Performance & Retrospectives: Partner with channel owners and analytics teams to capture learnings, improve operating processes, and build repeatable playbooks for high-frequency regional initiatives. About You We get excited about candidates who bring: 7+ years of experience in marketing operations, integrated marketing, campaign operations, creative operations, or program management, ideally in entertainment, streaming, technology, or another high-velocity consumer business. Proven experience building operational processes across multiple channels, markets, stakeholders, and time zones. Strong expertise in campaign planning, workback management, creative/localization workflows, approvals, and launch readiness. Experience with workflow and project-management platforms such as Wrike, Asana, Monday.com, Airtable, or similar tools. Excellent organizational judgment and the ability to simplify complex cross-functional work into clear plans, owners, and decisions. Strong stakeholder-management skills, including experience partnering with global teams, agencies, creative teams, and functional specialists. Comfort with budget tracking, vendor coordination, and operational reporting. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus. Passion for anime, entertainment, or fan-first brands is highly valued. About The Team LATAM GTM & Growth turns regional market opportunities into coordinated commercial plans that grow acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue. Marketing Operations provides the operating system that allows those plans to move from strategy to high-quality execution with speed, visibility, and accountability. Why you will love working at Crunchyroll In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks: Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually. Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self. Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance Health Saving Account HSA program Health care and dependent care FSA 401(k) plan, with employer match Employer paid commuter benefit Support program for new parents Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly! We value Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves. Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding. Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress. Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation. Questions about Crunchyroll’s hiring process? review_candidates.title: Sales Executive B2B Software - ERP environments
review_candidates.description: We are looking for two B2B software sales professionals who knows ERP environments and can take a deal from first contact to signature. Sales Executive - Europe The role Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens. You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement. There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close. What you will do Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory. Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers. Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team. Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market. Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price. Who you are Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles. Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one. Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver. Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead. At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors. AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way. A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound. Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively. What we offer A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us. A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay. A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.
